name: – Thomas Waitz – Recital G
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on North Macedonia
part_text: whereas, especially in complex historical contexts, matters of language, identity and culture are inherently sensitive; whereas adding such issues to the enlargement discussions risks complicating and politicising the accession process of candidate countries, and should therefore be addressed with restraint and responsibility, in a manner that preserves the integrity of the EU’s enlargement policy;
